_meta.description: Curated canonical-ingredient seed for Supernatural Ingredient Intelligence.
_meta.provenance: Names, identity type, material type, family and functions are CURATOR-PROPOSED (AI-assisted) and stored with reviewStatus=SUBMITTED. Candidate PubChem CIDs ('cid') are NOT stored as identifiers unless verified against PubChem PUG REST (see pubchem-verification.json). CAS numbers come only from PubChem registry-number cross-references of verified CIDs.
_meta.priorityNote: Tier 1 (Supernatural products) and tier 3 (textured-hair products) are computed by the seed loader from parsed product ingredient lists; 'p' here is the fallback tier for ingredients not found in any seeded product.
_meta.fields: k=key n=canonical (INCI where one exists) c=common name t=identityType m=materialType f=family fn=functions p=fallback priority tier r=priority reason o=origin cid=candidate PubChem CID a=aliases/synonyms b=botanical source [genus, species, part]
